买书按正常作息和实际报价付钱，有限库存2本，不自动补货。识字至少100并持有完好书；每次读一种法术，book.grade满足spell.stage；一阶须法师认证。智力检定，不是施法技能attribute。成功只登记法术和0熟练技能，不附魔力材料或精神许可。失败花完整阅读时间，保留书和购书成本，不另扣learnFee教学费。","spells":[{"id":"spell_s1_tinder","name":"点绒诀","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_tinder","stage":0,"mp":2,"minutes":1,"duration":0,"durationLimit":0,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"ignite","effectSpec":{"kind":"object","operation":"ignite","power":5000},"effect":"点燃登记器物里最多5000毫克真实干火绒，燃料实际消耗；不召出燃料。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_snuff","name":"断燃诀","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_snuff","stage":0,"mp":2,"minutes":1,"duration":0,"durationLimit":0,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"extinguish","effectSpec":{"kind":"object","operation":"extinguish","power":1},"effect":"停止登记器物的实际燃烧，已有热量留存，器壁仍可能烫手。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_warm_vessel","name":"器温缓升","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_warm_vessel","stage":0,"mp":3,"minutes":1,"duration":0,"durationLimit":0,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"heat","effectSpec":{"kind":"object","operation":"heat","power":5000,"limitC":40},"effect":"向非活体热器物最多输入5000焦耳热量，整体温度不超过40摄氏度；不加水、不点燃。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_touch_temperature","name":"触器知温","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_touch_temperature","stage":0,"mp":1,"minutes":1,"duration":0,"durationLimit":0,"rangeMeters":0,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"sense_heat","effectSpec":{"kind":"object","operation":"sense_heat","power":1},"effect":"接触登记器物读取整体温度，不诊断病症或透视内部。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_leak_seal","name":"水口暂封","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_leak_seal","stage":0,"mp":3,"minutes":1,"duration":10,"durationLimit":10,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"seal","effectSpec":{"kind":"water_earth","operation":"seal","power":20},"effect":"暂时封闭压力不高于20千帕的容器漏口，实际水仍在原容器，10分钟后恢复泄漏。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_channel_read","name":"浅沟量流","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_channel_read","stage":0,"mp":2,"minutes":1,"duration":0,"durationLimit":0,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"survey_water","effectSpec":{"kind":"water_earth","operation":"survey_water","power":5},"effect":"测量一段最多5米的小水道水深、实际流量与流速；不测水质或预报河流。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]},{"id":"spell_s1_slow_current","name":"缓沟诀","aliases":[],"scope":null,"skill":"skill_s1_slow_current","stage":0,"mp":3,"minutes":1,"duration":5,"durationLimit":5,"rangeMeters":3,"difficulty":10,"materials":[{"item":"item_charcoal","amount":1}],"mechanism":"slow_flow","effectSpec":{"kind":"water_earth","operation":"slow_flow","power":50},"effect":"把非洪峰小水道的有效流量与流速最多降低一半，持续5分钟，不净水或封死沟渠。","learnFee":12,"learnMinutes":120,"teachers":[]}],"stock":{"owner":"npc_hw_luqing","item":"item_book_s1_utility","quantity":2}},"draft":{"id":"item_book_s1_utility","prose":{"description":"这册未署名抄本收录点绒诀、断燃诀、器温缓升、触器知温、水口暂封、浅沟量流、缓沟诀。识字达到100并持有完好的书，才可每次用120分钟研读一种；一阶法术还须有法师认证。阅读失败仍花去时间，书与购书成本不会退还。","inspection":"逐页对照标题和篇末，检查有无缺页、大片洇墨或错接的书帖。抄本的笔迹只说明书写习惯，不能据此认定未署名作者的身份。","storage":"擦净手上的泥水再翻页，读后合进干燥书匣。用纸条标出篇次，避免折角遮住施术条件；存放时远离炉火与潮湿的器壁。"}}}
